significance: A Kali shrine at Naihati begun in 1923 by Bhavesh Chakraborty, a jute-mill worker and social worker, famous for the twenty-two-foot image raised each year at Kali Puja and dressed in some twelve kilograms of gold and two hundred of silver. A permanent temple with a stone image was inaugurated in 2023, and the immersion procession draws crowds large enough to need over a thousand police.
story: Chakraborty is said to have been told by Kali in a dream to shape her as a giant twenty-two-foot image like those he had seen at Nabadwip.
